title: Origins of house mice in ecological niches created by settled hunter-gatherers in the Levant 15,000 y ago
version: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

passages.quote: The data reveal the presence of dominant commensal populations of house mice in southern Levantine sedentary hunter-gatherer settlements as early as 15,000 B.P.

file.method: Passages of about 500 characters either side of each cited quotation, cut from the fetched page text.
